purpose: Teach: 交信/逆説/マニフェスト/点在/入港/強者/待合室/首席

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本部との交信体制を整備されてますね
lines.en: The police maintain well-organized communication systems with headquarters, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, respectful observation. Mild curiosity in the lift at the end. Steady pace. Acknowledging competence without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、逆説的捜査手法も用いられますね
lines.en: The police also employ counterintuitive investigative methods, I understand.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed. Slower pace. The tone of someone noting something clever they've observed. Gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、公約マニフェストを掲げる政治家を監視されますね
lines.en: The police keep watch on politicians who make campaign pledges, right?
lines.style: Casual observation with an undercurrent of mild skepticism. Light rhythm. The knowing nod of someone who's noticed the mechanics of things.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラが街に点在しております
lines.en: Security cameras are scattered throughout the town, I've noticed.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact. Observant but neutral. Even pace. No judgment — just the tone of noticing what's there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、密輸船の入港監視を強化されますね
lines.en: The police have stepped up monitoring of smuggling ships at the ports.
lines.style: Factual, competent. The tone of someone relaying something they've learned. Steady delivery. Slight authority in the knowledge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織の強者を狙われますね
lines.en: They target the leaders of criminal organizations, I gather.
lines.style: Calm, measured. The observation of someone who understands the logic of enforcement. Even rhythm. Slight distance — speaking of systems, not people.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署の待合室にも防犯を施されますね
lines.en: Even the station waiting rooms have security measures in place.
lines.style: Noticing the small details. Slightly wry — the observation of how thoroughly something is done. Unhurried pace. Mild amusement underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校首席の卒業生を歓迎されますね
lines.en: They certainly welcomed the top graduate from the police academy.
lines.style: Warm approval. Slight emphasis on 'top' — recognition of excellence. Comfortable, genuine. The tone of someone pleased about an achievement.
